Year-End Payroll Checklist for Tax Year 2026
Issued October 16, 2026 · Applies to all client companies on the Summit Ridge platform
By ⟦name|Maribel Quintanilla-Osei⟧, CPP, Director of Payroll Compliance

KEY DATES
  • Fri, Dec 18, 2026 — last day to submit off-cycle bonus runs for a 2026 check date (ACH needs 2 banking days;
    Dec 25 and Jan 1 are Federal Reserve holidays).
  • Thu, Dec 31, 2026 — final check date for tax year 2026. A check dated 1/1/2027 or later is 2027 wages, even if
    the work was done in 2026 (constructive receipt is not the test for W-2 wages — the check date is).
  • Mon, Feb 1, 2027 — Forms W-2/W-3 and 1099-NEC due to recipients and to SSA/IRS (Jan 31 falls on a Sunday);
    Form 941 for Q4 and Form 940 also due. If all deposits were made on time, 941/940 may be filed by Feb 10.
  • Wed, Mar 31, 2027 — e-file deadline for most other information returns (1099-MISC, 1099-INT, 1099-DIV).

2026 LIMITS IN THE SYSTEM
  Social Security wage base ................ $184,500   (6.2% employee / 6.2% employer)
  Medicare ................................. 1.45% / 1.45%, no wage base
  Additional Medicare (employee only) ...... 0.9% on wages over $200,000, regardless of filing status
  FUTA ..................................... 6.0% on first $7,000; 0.6% net with full state credit
  401(k)/403(b) elective deferral .......... $24,500; age 50+ catch-up $8,000; ages 60–63 catch-up $11,250
  HSA ...................................... $4,400 self-only / $8,750 family (+$1,000 age 55+)
  Dependent care FSA ....................... $7,500 per household (up from $5,000)

  Example: an employee in Tennessee paid $192,000 a year on a biweekly schedule ($7,384.62 per check) reaches
  the $184,500 wage base partway through the 25th check, so that check shows Social Security tax on only
  $7,269.50 and the 26th check shows none. This is expected — please don't open a ticket for it.

NEW FOR 2026: QUALIFIED TIPS AND QUALIFIED OVERTIME
  The One Big Beautiful Bill Act, signed by President Trump on July 4, 2025, lets employees deduct qualified tips
  (up to $25,000) and the premium portion of qualified overtime (up to $12,500, or $25,000 joint) on their 2025–2028
  individual returns. Withholding does not change, but employers must report these amounts separately on the 2026
  Form W-2. We will populate them from earning codes TIPQ (qualified tips, with the Treasury occupation code on
  the employee profile) and OTPREM (FLSA overtime premium only — the "half" in time-and-a-half). If your company
  pays daily overtime under state law, or overtime under a union contract above FLSA requirements, that excess is
  NOT qualified. Confirm your earning-code mapping in Settings › Earnings › Year-End Flags by November 30.

EMPLOYEE DATA HYGIENE BEFORE W-2s PRINT
  • Run Reports › Compliance › SSN Exceptions. It flags any SSN beginning with 9 (an ITIN cannot be used for
    wages — get the employee's SSN or mark "Applied For"), any 000 or 666 area number, and test values left over
    from implementation such as 123-45-6789, 111-11-1111 or 078-05-1120.
  • Never key 000-00-0000 as a placeholder. SSA Business Services Online rejects the whole file.
  • EINs on the W-3 must be in XX-XXXXXXX format. Several clients keyed a state unemployment account number
    (e.g., the 7-digit SC or 10-digit PA format) in the federal EIN field last year.
  • Ask employees to confirm mailing addresses in the app by Dec 11. Returned W-2s are re-mailed at $4.50 each.
  • Employees who moved states mid-year: check that state wages in Box 16 add up across all state rows to
    Box 1 (unless a state uses a different definition, e.g., Pennsylvania and 401(k) deferrals).

STATE ITEMS
  New York PFL, Washington PFML, Oregon Paid Leave and Colorado FAMLI 2027 rates are not yet final; we'll load
  them when published and confirm in the December bulletin (SRP-CB-2026-12). FUTA credit reduction states for
  2026 are announced by the Department of Labor in November; if your company has employees in a credit reduction
  state, the extra FUTA is billed with your final December invoice (Order No. format YE-2026-#####).
